Here’s a more polished and professional version of your sentence:

**"As suggested, moving forward, let’s explicitly include the SQL_ID in our requests to the L2/L4 team when seeking query tuning. This will help avoid unnecessary back-and-forth and expedite the investigation process."**

### Key Improvements:
1. **"Going forward" → "Moving forward"** – Slightly more natural in professional writing.
2. **"Specifically mention" → "Explicitly include"** – More precise and formal.
3. **"So there is no back and forth questioning delaying the investigation" → "This will help avoid unnecessary back-and-forth and expedite the investigation process"** – More concise and proactive.
4. **"Asking for query tuning" → "Seeking query tuning"** – More professional phrasing.
